headline: JSW Energy Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - JSW Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about intimation of receipt of certified copy of order sanctioning the Scheme of Arrangement between GE Power India Limited ( GEPIL  or  Demerged Company ) and JSW Energy…
detail: General Updates - JSW Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about intimation of receipt of certified copy of order sanctioning the Scheme of Arrangement between GE Power India Limited ( GEPIL  or  Demerged Company ) and JSW Energy Limited ( Company  or  Resulting Company ) and their respective shareholders under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 ( Scheme )
